programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of 'The Phantom Menace,' so that their terminally ill friend can see it before its release in theaters several months down the line.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: A wannabe dad mistakes a vertically challenged criminal on the lam as his newly adopted son.

programme.title: Dickie Roberts: Former Child Star
programme.desc: Desperate to revive his career, Dickie tries to audition for a role in Rob Reiner's new movie but the director doesn't believe Dickie is normal enough to play the part.

programme.desc: A loner with a passion for trains inherits an empty train station in the middle of nowhere. He encounters unexpected neighbors and with absolutely nothing in common, they form a friendship none of them could foresee.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP03 Hustler vs. Magician [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi head off to school to start the new term... except Ishiyama High is still completely destroyed thanks to a certain someone. So instead, all the students from Ishiyama are split up and sent off to different high schools temporarily. Furuichi is all excited since they're heading to St. Ishiyama Academy, the most prestigious school in the area, but when they get there the reality of exactly how they are treated becomes apparent...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga gains his own follower in Kazuya, who will do anything to become strong like Oga. Oga, increasingly annoyed at Kazuya tailing him everywhere, finally decides to train him. Meanwhile, Aoi is jealous of how easily Azusa, Kazuya's childhood friend, can act cute and girly in front of a guy, and invites her for a little chat to the shrine where she lives.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Angelica is visiting the Human World for her birthday, and Furuichi is all excited for his big sleepover! But Angelica brought an unexpected gift with her from the Demon World... Yes, they're back! It's a Yople Alien! Knowing the grave danger this poses the city, nay, the world, Angelica does the only thing you can do in this situation: Recruit a 5 member squad of pseudo magical girls and partner with a muscled Moyashi-man to defeat the Blue Ears and save the day!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP01 The Revived Phantom Thief Kid [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Mr. Stewart drops by for a surprise visit, Chris and Chuck are barely able to keep Sonic and Friends' stay a secret and after Chris' uncle arrives, things get messier. Everyone, including Ella and Mr. Tanaka, are going to find out!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman discovers that he is being watched by the military he sends E-90 to swallow the satellite, but this disrupts everyone's TVs! So, Chuck and Tails decide to upgrade the Tornado into X-Tornado, allowing Sonic to enter high altitude in order to destroy E-90.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Chris, Amy, Cream and Cheese arrive at a resort, Eggman appears and tries to take over with his E-39 but Sonic arrives and tries to stop him. However Sonic is unable to swim, and the robot tries to drag him into the ocean!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: It's Team Sonic vs Team Eggman in a game of baseball for a Chaos Emerald! Team Sonic falls behind at first but then wins with a Sonic super-play, only to have Eggman to cheat and try to steal the Emerald regardless!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP85 The ICPO’s Secret Order [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: ICPO Bureau Chief Jasmine is an able commissioner. She uses the governor to spur Zenigata into action, as she has a secret plan to arrest Lupin. But Jasmine's plan is to make this mission her very last at ICPO so she could get married. Who is Jasmine marrying? Will her plan to arrest Lupin succeed?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP86 The Mysterious Nocturnal Mask [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Nocturnal Mask murdered the Duke of Le Mond and stole his diamonds. ICPO is having trouble solving the case, so they induct mystery author Conan Drill as a special inspector. Drill deduces that the true identity of Nocturnal Mask is Lupin. Learning that Count Johannes is his next target, he and Zenigata lie in wait at the Johannes Mansion, where a costume ball is taking place ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP87 When the Devil Calls to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In a night of thunder and rain, a man gives Lupin a doll. That very night Lupin has a nightmare of being manipulated by a man named Mephistopheles. The next day there is a news report that a diamond called the Phoenix Tear had been stolen. Though Lupin had been caught on security camera, he has no recollection of having done the deed. What is going on?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP88 Lupin's North Pole, South Pole Adventure [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin's target is the Vatican Crown, located at the North Pole. He devises a plan to thwart pesky Fujiko, which is to relocate penguins at the South Pole to the North Pole; Lupin takes a flight to the South Pole to gather penguins, then heads to the North Pole. But Fujiko learns of his antics and with the help of an underground organization called the Red Voyagers League, heads to the North Pole. Who will claim the prize of the Vatican Crown?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP89 Play the Thief's Symphony [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Worldwide Crime Prevention Association has developed the "killer safe" that sent many safe crackers to their graves. Their ultimate product is the atomic safe, located 100 meters underground, which is said to detect sounds and detonate, blowing thieves to smithereens. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Sadohara thinks that by making the Ishiyama students do their own physical examinations that they're sure to cause trouble, which would be enough to get them all expelled! programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Raising Baby Beel isn't getting any easier, and Oga is determined once again to find someone to dump him off on. Who exactly are these 6 Holy Knights?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: While trying to retrieve the 7th Chaos Emerald from Dr. Eggman, Sonic and Friends are transported to the human world where Sonic is rescued by a boy named Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic discovers that Cream and Cheese are being held captive by the military. Sonic, with the help of Chris and his grandfather Chuck, finds and frees them only to be caught in a trap!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Eggman tries to use E-23 to take over the world Amy, Knuckles and Tails launch an unsuccessful counterattack, until Sonic arrives! And with a ring from Tails, Sonic destroys E-23 and saves Amy with the help of Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris' teacher has been replaced with the President's spy, Mr. Stewart. Meanwhile, the first Chaos Emerald appears at a construction site. It's then a race to the stone between Eggman and Sonic!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman tricks Knuckles into blaming Sonic for being stuck in the human world, Knuckles challenges Sonic to a duel! But Knuckles realizes he's being duped and teams up with Sonic to destroy the robot and save the others.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP80 The Last Gift in Prison is Cup Ramen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Silver, who once worked with Lupin on a train robbery, stole the money himself, hid it somewhere, and promptly got himself thrown into prison on a rinky-dink charge. Lupin, having learned that Silver is about to be released, goes to the prison intent on making Silver tell what he did with the loot, only to discover that, while Silver was in prison, a new top-of-the-line prison was built over the site where he hid the money. Now, will the operation to trade an execution for the recovery of the money succeed?!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP81 Fujiko, Men are A Sorry Lot! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin is after the Golden Bell, symbol of the monarchy of Beltenberg and precious tourist attraction. However, the bell that sparkles in the belfry is just a brass replica. Though Fujiko insists that the bell made of gold doesn't exist, Lupin believes to the contrary. Meanwhile, Lupin gets news of Fujiko's engagement to prince Claude of Beltenberg, whom she had met in Paris.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP82 Hostage Rescue Operation: Pops [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Zenigata is taken hostage from ICPO headquarters. The terrorists demand to swap him with their boss Napoleon XI, but ICPO refuses. Since Zenigata is no further use to them, the terrorists are bound to kill him; Lupin must now come to his rescue but do it delicately so as to not hurt Zenigata's pride. Thus, begins Lupin's Zenigata-rescue caper ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP83 Lupin’s Big Western [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Smith Gang hit-man company was once the best in the business, but they're suffering now from tough competition. Though the company chairman Smith considers running TV ads to revive his business, he can't think of a good way to do it. Fujiko gets word that he's willing to shovel out 300 million dollars for a good idea, so they decide to film a Western in which Lupin gets killed ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP84 Leave the Revenge to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Though Joe Spade was once a formidable hitman of renown and Jigen's sharpshooter coach, he now comes to beg for Jigen's help; he had gotten old, flubbed a hit contract, and is now on the run. Jigen decides to help his old mentor and heads to Mareseilles with Lupin, but Lupin has a change of heart because he hates killers. So Jigen heads to Jigen's ramshakle shack all by himself ...

That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: We live in a world with light. Our eyes enable us to see, but just a small portion of the world. But other animals, such as certain snakes and insects, have developed the ability to detect infrared radiation. It allows them to see objects in low light. Now, researchers from China and the U.S. have come up with a solution that could do away with the bulky equipment.

programme.title: Harnessing the power of motion
programme.desc: Wheezing, coughing, choking. The cost of fossil fuels haunts us. And the reality is clear – the damage they cause is irreparable. That has spurred efforts to harness energy from the wind, sun, and rushing waters. Yet these still come up short on efficiency, or risk destroying natural habitats. But an alternative to renewable energy is on the horizon. Triboelectricity.

programme.title: Davos 2026: China's AI Economy
programme.desc: With 87% of Chinese companies planning to increase AI investment in 2025 and more than half reporting faster than expected progress, China’s AI momentum is accelerating. Simultaneously, the State Council’s AI Action Plan is pushing adoption in priority sectors, from manufacturing and energy to healthcare, finance and retail. CGTN host Guan Xin hosts a panel discussion at World Economic Forum's Annual Meeting with distinguished guests in the AI sector, to examine how China’s evolving AI architecture can close that gap and what lessons its AI approach offers for global AI strategies.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.sub-title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.sub-title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.sub-title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.10
programme.desc: Where Ningxia's desert frontiers give way to the Yellow River's 397km embrace, they carve out a distinctive landscape that is any but dry and arid. Come and see a land of oases where sand and dust give way to a terrain as lush and green as the lands south of the Yangtze!

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Planet Dinosaur

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Abundance"
programme.desc: Na gesurft te hebben in Zagreb, en nadat Leon de turbulente geschiedenis van Sarajevo heeft leren kennen, gaan hij op de Kindness One® naar Montenegro. Daar ontmoet hij een vriendelijke boer, wiens familie al 20 generaties lang hetzelfde land bewerkt. Dit inspireert hem tot zijn volgende verrassingscadeau.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill is altijd al gefascineerd geweest door de America's Cup-zeilrace – en die is net zo intens als de naam doet vermoeden. Maar het echte avontuur beleeft hij in een Sovjet Mig-jet: hij vliegt mee, voert stunts uit en maakt zenuwslopende laagvliegers mee.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kushtia, Bangladesh"
programme.desc: De broers doorkruisen het onderling verbonden netwerk van waterwegen per veerboot. Van een garnalenbaron tot eenvoudige vissers, van eeuwenoude tempelruïnes tot anonieme chai wallahs – ze banen zich een weg naar Kushtia, de thuisbasis van het heiligdom van Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal"
programme.desc: Met speciale visa op zak regelen de broers 10 pony’s en 6 dragers en beginnen ze aan een adembenemende, maar zware 13-daagse ponytocht over de Himalaya naar de Mustang-vallei, waar ze hopen een ontmoeting met de koning te regelen.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Fiji"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verlaat de gebaande paden en trekt van het ene afgelegen dorp naar het andere door het bergachtige landschap van Fiji.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent het wereldberoemde Abel Tasman National Park te voet en per zeekajak.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Peru"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson dompelt zich onder in de fascinerende cultuur van Peru en verkent de wandelroutes en eeuwenoude ruïnes van de Heilige Vallei.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Ohrigstad to Pilgrims Rest"
programme.desc: Van de Echogrotten tot het historische Pilgrim's Rest, Xander begint zich weer thuis te voelen op de regio in Zuid-Afrika waar hij is opgegroeid.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Winelands of the Cape"
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn team genieten van heerlijke gerechten en wijn bij het wijnhuis Spier, brengt Adam zijn dag door met het maken van cider en doorzoeken van familiebezittingen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Grabouw to Botriver"
programme.desc: Een wijnboerderij omringd door bergen, een dag wandelen inclusief picknicken, en verrukkelijk eten in combinatie met eersteklas wijn staat op het programma voor Xander en zijn team op hun route van Grabouw naar Botrivier.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Service"
programme.desc: In Kosovo ontmoet Leon een moslimvrouw die droomt van vrede. Wat motorproblemen in Griekenland openen de deur voor avontuur. De gastvrijheid op grote hoogte in Turkije inspireert hem tot het volgende verrassingscadeau.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Tomorrow"
programme.desc: Leon ontvangt een eervolle zegen op zijn reis. In Efeze treedt Leon in de voetsporen van apostel Paulus, voordat de escalatie van een conflict in het Midden-Oosten zijn reis in gevaar brengen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Education"
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness One® bezoeken 's werelds beroemdste monument van de liefde, de Taj Mahal, voordat hun reis op een muur stuit - letterlijk. Na een dag hard werken op een Indiase boerderij reist Leon naar de Stad van Vuur.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"
programme.desc: Fietsen is doorgaans een veilige en ontspannen bezigheid – totdat je het doet in de wildernis van Kenia, tussen leeuwen, olifanten en buffels.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Wild Indonesia"
programme.desc: Bill had twee wilde iconen die hij per se wilde meemaken. De eerste: de grootste hagedis ter wereld – de Komodovaraan. Tussen deze reusachtige beesten lopen was op zijn zachtst gezegd zenuwslopend. De andere: de enige mensaap van Azië – de orang-oetan.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Indonesia"
programme.desc: Van alle bucketlist-ervaringen springt er één erbovenuit: het aanschouwen van een van de oorspronkelijke redenen voor de oprichting van de UNESCO-Werelderfgoedlijst – de indrukwekkende tempel van Borobudur.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada"
programme.desc: In een bushplane vliegen de broers naar het uiterste punt van ‘The Rock’ en keren ze terug naar het ruige, afgelegen eiland waar ze zijn geboren. Per kajak peddelen ze van visserijhaven naar visserijhaven, totdat ze hun ultieme bestemming bereiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "The First Wall"
programme.desc: Ash’ reis langs de Chinese Muur begint op het meest oostelijke punt, bij een eeuwenoud deel dat bekendstaat als de Chu-Muur. Daarna reist Ash naar de Shaolintempel in de stad Dengfeng om kennis te maken met hun eeuwenoude gebruiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: Vanaf Old Dragon’s Head trekt Ash westwaarts, waar hij een Muurbeschermer ontmoet die zijn leven heeft gewijd aan het behoud van dit iconische bouwwerk. Daarna maakt hij zich op voor een onverwacht avontuur: duiken bij de onder water gelopen resten van de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Re-live"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering herbeleven Rob en Dave enkele van de hoogtepunten van hun ongelofelijke reis van 6000 km.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: Cody is samen met Lexi Limitless in de 'Big Easy' om New Orleans te verkennen en bezoekt een verlaten liefdadigheidsziekenhuis voordat hij Brutus, de gigantische alligator, ontmoet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Yerevan"
programme.desc: Josh verkent de buurt in Armenië en de hoofdstad Yerevan, bezoekt enkele verlaten Sovjet gebouwen, een breifabriek en een luxe hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Gary, Indiana"
programme.desc: Josh is terug in Gary, Indiana, voor een lokale verkenningstocht. Samen met vrienden bezoekt hij een voormalige bank, het gedenkauditorium en treinstation Union.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "New South Wales, Australia"
programme.desc: Nieuw-Zuid-Wales is de thuisbasis van Sydney, met het iconische Opera House en Harbour Bridge. Bill probeert de gigantische stalen constructie te beklimmen om de stad van bovenaf te bewonderen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Siberia & Mongolia"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering reis je letterlijk naar enkele van de meest afgelegen plekken ter wereld. Eerst een bezoek aan Siberië… een van de meest onherbergzame gebieden op aarde – al blijken veel van de angstaanjagende verhalen grotendeels mythen te zijn.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De Filippijnen zijn een ongelooflijke bestemming met talloze herinneringen aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog, historische connecties die teruggaan tot Magellan en een gelukkige, vriendelijke bevolking.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Lake Titicaca, Peru"
programme.desc: De broers liften vanuit de oude Inca-hoofdstad Cuzco langs de ruggengraat van de Andes naar het Titicacameer. Ze krijgen te maken met ernstige hoogteziekte, kauwen op cocabladeren om op krachten te blijven en ontmoeten lokale bewoners terwijl ze zich een weg banen door het Andesgebergte.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Luxor, Egypt"
programme.desc: Voor hun reis door Egypte kiezen de broers een felucca, een eeuwenoud handelsvaartuig. Ze varen noordwaarts over de Nijl, van de oasestad Aswan naar de oude stad Luxor, voordat ze een gigantische zandduin ontdekken waar ze vanaf glijden.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Abisko, Swedish Lapland"
programme.desc: Lapland is een bevroren winterland vol rendieren, Sami-tradities en sauna’s. De broers beginnen in Stockholm en vliegen 200 kilometer recht naar het noorden, boven de poolcirkel. Hun vervoermiddel voor deze reis: een rendierslee.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Winter in Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson keert terug naar Banff National Park en Lake Louise in de wintermaanden om het ongerepte achterland te verkennen met sneeuwschoenen en een snowboard.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "The Jordan Trail"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Jordanië om de nieuw ontwikkelde ‘Jordan Trail’ te bewandelen – een 450 mijl lange route die het hele land doorkruist en langs enkele van ’s werelds meest inspirerende landschappen en historische locaties voert, waaronder de oude stad Petra.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson bezoekt wilde en afgelegen dorpen in Papoea-Nieuw-Guinea en daagt zichzelf uit op een van de zwaarste paden ter wereld, de Kokoda Track.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Their Adventure Begins"
programme.desc: Twee adrenalinkejunks die niets liever willen dan een off-road avontuur op de motor. En ze gaan hun meest epische reis ooit tegemoet, naar Argentinië.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Broken Bike"
programme.desc: Rob en Dave verleggen hun grenzen. Ze vechten zich een ruige weg door zinderende zandduinen , waarbij de begroeiing ervoor zorgt dat Rob niet door kan gaan.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Separate Riders"
programme.desc: Het geduld van Rob en Dave wordt op de proef gesteld en de gehele trip is afhankelijk van de gebroken koppeling van Rob. Moeten ze een nieuwe motor kopen?

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: In Epic Exploring: Going Local wordt Zagreb, Kroatië bezocht. Cody vuurt een kanon af in de oude toren, verkent een nooit afgebouwd universiteitsziekenhuis en een politiekschool.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Joy"
programme.desc: Leon is mogelijk gestrand, wanneer Kindness One® in Patna stopt met werken. Later vervult hij de droom van elke Engelsman in Darjeeling, voordat hij naar Bhutan reist om het "Bruto Nationaal Geluk" in actie te zien.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Protection"
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness One® moeten de lange route nemen om naar Thailand te reizen, maar tocht slaagt hij er in om het tot een avontuur te maken. In Cambodja vervult Leon een kinderdroom wanneer hij de oude tempel van Angkor Wat bezoekt.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Brazil’s Pantanal"
programme.desc: Er is waarschijnlijk geen plek op aarde die zo rijk is aan wilde dieren als de Pantanal in Brazilië. In deze Quest gaat Bill enkele van de regenwoudwezens opsporen die hij altijd al heeft willen zien.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Rwanda"
programme.desc: Men zegt dat de tijd alle wonden heelt, maar kan zij ook de meest afschuwelijke helen – genocide? In deze Quest keert Bill terug naar Rwanda om te zien hoe dit kleine, maar wereldwijd betekenisvolle land na de oorlog genezing en verzoening vindt.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Canada’s Sunshine Coast, BC"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar de prachtige Sunshine Coast in British Columbia om de 180 kilometer lange Sunshine Coast Trail te verkennen en zijn zenuwen te testen in het Coast Gravity Downhill Mountain Bike Park.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Peak District & Derbyshire"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trekt naar het Peak District in Engeland om de 430 kilometer lange Pennine Way – de oudste en meest uitdagende langeafstandswandelroute van Groot-Brittannië – aan te pakken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In zijn zwaarste uitdaging tot nu toe waagt Ash zich aan Eagle’s Neck – een berucht steil en gevaarlijk stuk van de Chinese Muur. Maar eerst ontmoet hij technologie-experts die helpen de Muur digitaal in kaart te brengen, met als doel haar te beschermen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In zijn zwaarste uitdaging tot nu toe waagt Ash zich aan Eagle’s Neck – een berucht steil en gevaarlijk stuk van de Chinese Muur. Maar eerst ontmoet hij technologie-experts die helpen de Muur digitaal in kaart te brengen, met als doel haar te beschermen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De eilandstaat met 7.000 eilanden heeft geen gebrek aan strand, zon of zee – maar kampt met een hardnekkig imagoprobleem als het om de keuken gaat. Jonathan landt in Manila en ontdekt al snel dat de topchefs zich maar al te goed bewust zijn van dit probleem. Op hun advies vertrekt hij op expeditie om een deel van de oplossing te vinden. De reis voert hem van dorpen van voormalige koppensnellers, via koloniale stadjes waar de tijd heeft stilgestaan, tot restaurants in de schaduw van het Amerikaanse militaire machtsblok. Gaandeweg ontvouwt zich een intrigerend verhaal. In de dichte jungle blijft het ene geheim begraven, terwijl het andere letterlijk uit het houtwerk tevoorschijn komt. Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.desc: Berlin suffered from an image problem for decades. But the city at the epicentre of World War 2 is steadily gaining notoriety for all the right reasons. It’s the leading start up city in Europe; uber-cool and decidedly cosmopolitan.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Canberra"
programme.desc: Canberra is the youngest city to feature in our series; a mere “adolescent” in our rapidly urbanizing world. It stands out for all the right reasons as it affords those who live within its low-density realm a very privileged lifestyle indeed.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Education"
programme.desc: Can students just simply put on VR headsets and “attend”class from the comfort of their own homes? In this episode, we take a look at some of the latest VR apps for school education and after school VR games.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Safety"
programme.desc: VR can be used in practical applications like training and road safety, but find out how that sensory overload can lead to error in judgment.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Gaming"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the development of VR content and hardware meant to improve on the ‘reality’ of VR and the latest games featuring novel and exciting virtual worlds.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "TV&Film"
programme.desc: The art of moving visuals has long been used to evoke emotion and empathy in the viewer. Film and TV productions are implementing VR to give viewers an immersive experience where it’s just like “being there”.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "ATV Accidents"
programme.desc: ATVs have allowed us to penetrate the wilderness like never before. But they’ve also made the backcountry a bit more dangerous. Laura and Nick rig up some dramatic, high-speed tests to see how accidents happen and what you can do to protect yourself.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Alternative Energy Sources"
programme.desc: In this installment, Athena decodes some of the difficulties faced by the scientists & environmentalists looking to fundamentally change our relationship with energy.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Theories Of Everything"
programme.desc: Over the centuries, scientific theories have emerged that rival religious cosmology in terms of ambition and scope. But can science ever truly explain everything?

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Magnificent Mixtures"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we mix up some fireworks made from tin foil, whip up a stinky polymer, and try out an alchemy staple - turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Up and Atom"
programme.desc: This week's experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Hot Hot Heat"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat, how a little bit of melted candle wax can turn into a bomb, and why heat is an essential ingredient in cooking an egg.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Explosive Elements"
programme.desc: This week's experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Speedskating"
programme.desc: Speed skater Beorn Nijenhuis and presenter Julien Kang visit laboratories to ask how does technology help to make the difference between silver and gold?

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Snowboarding"
programme.desc: How do innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe?

programme.title: World’s Best Electric Cars
programme.desc: Alexis Conran investigates as the World gears up to make the switch from diesel and petrol to electric cars.

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "History of the Roller Skate"
programme.desc: Take a ride through the history of the roller skate, explore the ancient art of baking, and find out more about the versatile Bamboo plant and it’s many uses’ from medicine to musical instruments.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Shore to Shore"
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA on Mars.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Mars: Adapt or Leave"
programme.desc: As the latest successes and failures come and go Mars continues to give up her secrets. Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space & Shelter"
programme.desc: Resources are tight in space. Everything that goes up there has mass and therefore a cost.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "World Wide Wifi"
programme.desc: How will “world wide wifi” change the world again?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Strange Space Recipes"
programme.desc: Survival anywhere requires that we adapt to our surroundings but how will humans adapt to survive in space?

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Risk Taking, Money Making"
programme.desc: Torie and Larry duke it out on the auction floor for an incredible artefact. Cole meets astronaut Scott Parazynski who risked his life on one of the most daring spacewalks ever.

programme.desc: A visiting biker makes Peter and Nance feel old and unsexy, prompting them to resort to drastic measures. Guest star Joanna Newsom.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The 10th anniversary party for Toni and Candace's feminist bookstore is interrupted by a surprise guest. Guest stars Penny Marshall, LaMarcus Aldridge.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Fred & Carrie convince the Mayor to launch a campaign to ban the Olympics from Portland. Guest stars Greg Louganis, Kyle MacLachlan, Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portland's hottest brunch spot welcomes all the residents of Portlandia... but there's a wait. Guest stars Tim Robbins Kyle MacLachlan, Steve Jones.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: It's wintertime in Portlandia. Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets. Candace's son (Bobby Moynihan) visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: In this Season 3 premiere, Spyke & Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens. A group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor. Sandra has a crush on a man in her meditation class.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland. A pedicab driver hustles for clients. Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The daylong event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kickstarter videos compete at the Can'ts Film Festival (hosted by Gus Van Sant). Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team. Guest starring Gus Van Sant, Paul Allen, The Portland Trail Blazers & dancers.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Brendan and Michelle decide that it's finally time to try drugs. Carrie's brother (Josh Homme) comes to visit with his new boyfriend. Women and Women First is visited by the cops. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Dan Savage, and Josh Homme.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Mr. Mayor (Kyle MacLachlan) unveils Portland's official 3D Printer. Santa is concerned about the future of Christmas. A minister (Ed Begley Jr.) reminds us that church is an option.

programme.desc: Portlandia gets away for the weekend to New Beavertown, Oregon. Toni and Candace lead a feminist moon retreat for women (including k.d. lang).

programme.title: Eliminators
programme.desc: Martin Parker (Scott Adkins), a highly trained former DEA agent, is hiding in the witness protection program in London with his young daughter, Carly. His world is turned upside down when a group of thugs break into his home looking for hidden contraband.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

programme.title: Crimebusters
programme.desc: Two penniless friends decide to rob a store--but end up instead in a police office where they are drafted as new recruits. Starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: Two women become bank robbers to help the poor and seek revenge on a ruthless land baron.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Director Simon West and Nicolas Cage team-up for the first time since the 1997 blockbuster CON AIR for STOLEN, a unique fast paced action thriller that takes place during 10 frantic hours on Mardi Gras day in New Orleans. \r.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Rise of the Jurassic
programme.desc: A young scientist and her team arrive at a mysterious island, looking for answers as to what happened to her father who disappeared there years ago. What they find is beyond what any of them expected.

programme.title: Encounter
programme.desc: A group of friends make a remarkable discovery in a rural field - a crashed spacecraft - And there's a survivor. But when they bring the otherworldly being home, they soon discover that it holds even greater secrets than they could imagine.

programme.title: Walkaway Joe
programme.desc: In the tradition of American classics, WALKAWAY JOE is the story of an unlikely friendship between a young boy searching for his father, and a wandering loner hiding from his past. In each other they experience the power of a second chance, and a shot at redemption.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Salt and fire
programme.desc: A scientist blames the head of a large company for an ecological disaster in South America. But when a volcano begins to show signs of erupting, they must unite to avoid a disaster.

programme.title: Wire Room
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars in this explosive thriller as a federal agent caught in chaos when a rookie in Homeland Security’s Wire Room crosses a cartel arms dealer. With corrupt cops, a rogue guard, and a deadly SWAT team closing in, they must fight to survive and expose a conspiracy.

programme.title: Due Justice
programme.desc: An attorney with a military past hunts down the gang who killed his wife and took his daughter.

programme.title: Pressed
programme.desc: Seeing no other option, Brian decides to go all in and invests his remaining savings into a short-term drug deal, promised to yield the funds necessary to preserve his high-flying lifestyle.

programme.title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Director Simon West and Nicolas Cage team-up for the first time since the 1997 blockbuster CON AIR for STOLEN, a unique fast paced action thriller that takes place during 10 frantic hours on Mardi Gras day in New Orleans. \r.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: It’s a race for survival in the criminal underworld of New York in the action-packed thriller TRACERS.

programme.title: Instrument of War
programme.desc: Instrument Of War is an harrowing yet uplifting true story about survival against seemingly impossible odds. When U.S. B-24 bomber pilot Clair Cline is shot down and captured in northern Germany, one war ends and another begins -- to keep hope alive.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: From the pages of Marvel Comics — creators of X-Men and Spider-Man — comes ELEKTRA, the first action-event movie of the year. In the ultimate battle between good and evil stands a warrior who makes the choice that tips the balance.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: Two women become bank robbers to help the poor and seek revenge on a ruthless land baron.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Set in 1903, Tracker is a tense action thriller in which Arjan (Ray Winstone), a guerrilla survivor of the South African Boer War, lands in colonial New Zealand and is promised a huge bounty to capture Kereama (Temuera Morrison), a Maori seafarer accused of killing a British soldier.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Aspiring storm-chaser William is determined to continue his father's legacy by chasing the most dangerous supercell tornado ever seen.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former protégé to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: DRIVE is the story of a Hollywood stunt driver by day (Ryan Gosling), a loner by nature, who moonlights as a top-notch getaway driver-for-hire in the criminal underworld. He finds himself a target for some of LA's most dangerous men after agreeing to aid the husband of his beautiful neighbour.

programme.title: Wire Room
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars in this explosive thriller as a federal agent caught in chaos when a rookie in Homeland Security’s Wire Room crosses a cartel arms dealer. With corrupt cops, a rogue guard, and a deadly SWAT team closing in, they must fight to survive and expose a conspiracy.

programme.title: Tiger House
programme.desc: When Kelly sneaks into her boyfriend's house one night, she soon discovers she isn’t the only unwelcome visitor. A violent gang – lead by determined boss Shane have invaded the property and are holding the family hostage for an unknown ransom.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: When a young boy's mother dies, he invents an imaginary friend to accompany him to his new home far away. How can a boy be lonely with a gentle giant named Bogus? Gerard Depardieu and Whoopi Goldberg star together for the first time in this warmhearted tale of magic and fantasy.

programme.title: Greener Grass
programme.desc: GREENER GRASS is a hilariously deadpan hellscape of competitive suburbia with a boldly stylized absurdist chain of events that unfurls with increasing fervour after one soccer mom gifts another her infant daughter just to be polite.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.\r.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace (Selena Gomez) is an ordinary girl who becomes an accidental princess when a family summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime. Living like royalty, Grace, along with her two best friends, discovers who she really is – by assuming another person’s identity.

programme.title: Smother
programme.desc: After being fired from his job, an everyday guy faces pressure from his wife about having a baby, while having to deal with his suffocating mother, who has decided to move in with the couple.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the Devil who slyly promises to do just that - for a price.

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: The Boy Downstairs
programme.desc: A writer returning to New York after a two-year stint in London, Diana (Zosia Mamet) is searching for a new residence.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

programme.title: Ms. White Light
programme.desc: The story of Lex, a woman who counsels terminally ill clients. While proving uniquely talented in her ability to connect with the dying, Lex is at a total loss when it comes to dealing with everyone else. When Valerie refuses to play by Lex's rules, Lex is forced to question her own decisions.

programme.title: Everything Must Go
programme.desc: After delivering an inspiring presentation to his sales staff, Nick is fired for falling off the wagon one last time. He returns home to discover his wife has left him, changed the locks on their suburban home and dumped all his possessions out on the front yard.

programme.title: Welcome to Me
programme.desc: Welcome to Me is about a year in the life of Alice Klieg (Kristen Wiig), a woman with Borderline Personality Disorder who wins Megamillions, quits her meds and buys herself a TV show where she talks only, and exclusively, about herself.

programme.title: Severance
programme.desc: Working nine to five is a real killer, but team-building holidays can be even worse. Seven colleagues find themselves faced with the chop when their corporate weekend in the wilds of Eastern Europe descends into a deadly nightmare.

programme.desc: We're catching up on our beauty sleep! Stay tuned for more priceless entertainment curated by Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Electric Jesus
programme.desc: When a promoter sells a Christian metal band on the promise of a summer tour in 1986, their desire to "make Jesus famous" meets the complexities and confusion of personal ambition, youthful zeal, lifelong friendships, and first love.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Smother
programme.desc: After being fired from his job, an everyday guy faces pressure from his wife about having a baby, while having to deal with his suffocating mother, who has decided to move in with the couple.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly got married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot after having their annulment denied by a judge.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.\r.

programme.title: Hudson
programme.desc: After his mother’s death, Hudson, a reclusive but charming man, embarks on a journey with his distant cousin to scatter his mother’s ashes in the Hudson Valley region of New York.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: A traveling art saleswoman (Jennifer Aniston) tries to shake off a flaky motel manager who falls for her and won't leave her alone.

programme.title: Clairevoyant
programme.desc: A yoga-practicing girl hires a TV crew to document her journey to enlightenment to self-discovery, comparing the past, her painful present, and the unspiritual scene in Los Angeles.

programme.title: The 4th
programme.desc: It’s the 4th of July in Los Angeles, when Jamie, an illustrator who can barely pay his rent, tries to throw a party while his bully roommate is out of town. But everything seems to go wrong.

programme.title: Gatlopp: Hell of a Game
programme.desc: Jumanji meets Escape Room. It’s going to be one hell of a game. Four friends reunite for game night to forget the trauma of adult life. With mischief, booze and mayhem on the cards, are they playing the game or is the game playing them.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: When the banks committed the greatest fraud in US history, four outsiders risked it all to take them down. Based on the unbelievable true story and best-selling book from the author of The Blind Side and Moneyball, critics are calling The Big Short “brilliant and explosive”..

programme.title: Grey Matter
programme.desc: Teenager Chloe has never been close with her Nan Peg but when she gets diagnosed with Alzheimer's and moves into the family home, Chloe's forced to become her stay-at-home carer overnight.

programme.title: The Journey
programme.desc: After 40 years of "The Troubles" in Northern Ireland the leading players meet at St. Andrews to try and hammer out a final and lasting peace agreement.

programme.title: Five Nights in Maine
programme.desc: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: In this acclaimed Western, travelling settlers find themselves stranded in harsh conditions and begin to turn upon each other.

programme.title: The Body
programme.desc: A crucified body dated back to the first century A.D is uncovered at an ancient cave in Jerusalem. Trouble ensues as word spreads.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine
programme.desc: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: 1879, nine-year-old Maria Sautuola and her father, Marcelino, discover the first cave art and accomplished paintings of galloping bison. But Maria's mother, devout Conchita, is disturbed at the idea that prehistoric savages could have created such magnificent art.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The unbelievable true story of Barry Minkow, the youngest person ever to defraud Wall Street and who by the age of 21 was worth a staggering 100 million dollars.

programme.title: Louder Than Words
programme.desc: After the unexpected death of their daughter, a couple work to build a state of the art children's hospital where families are welcomed into the healing process.

programme.title: Daruma
programme.desc: Patrick (bitter wheelchair user) enlists the help of his cantankerous neighbor Robert (double amputee) to transport the four-year-old daughter he never knew he had to live with her maternal grandparents on the other side of the country.

programme.title: Adam Resurrected

Edgy, conflicted, sarcastic, and misunderstood, Hancock's well-intentioned heroics might get the job done and save countless lives, but always seem to leave jaw-dropping damage in their wake. The public has finally had enough--as grateful as they are to have their local hero, the good citizens of Los Angeles are wondering what they ever did to deserve this guy. Hancock isn't the kind of man who cares what other people think--until the day that he saves the life of PR executive Ray Embrey, and the sardonic superhero begins to realize that he may have a vulnerable side after all. Facing that will be Hancock's greatest challenge yet--and a task that may prove impossible as Ray's wife, Mary, insists that he's a lost cause.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.
